spiritgiven.comments: You are so much fun and set a great example of attitude which we aspire to follow throughout the tournament. Our energy rose because of your positivity and enthusiasm. We really appreciated the fair mindedness where teammates encouraged each other to retract calls they felt were wrong, in addition to the open mindedness to hear these conflicting perspectives. Grasias Colombia

2. We gave feedback in the first half about body contact and felt that there wasn’t a big adjustment in the second half. 
5. We were all very surprised by the feedback given to us in the spirit circle, considering that nothing was communicated to us at any point during the game and we weren’t given an opportunity to improve. The spirit circle felt negative and took away from the overall enjoyment of the game.

Thanks India for a great game, we loved your attitude and fair mindedness during discussions. A few minor points for improvement would be to learn some of the rules/processes of resetting the disc back into play after calls/discussions and adhering to time limits. We identified that both teams could be better at using and echoing hand signals on the field.
We want to commend your positivity, celebration of all good plays, respectful communication and great rules knowledge. Thank you for role-modelling excellent hand signals and teaching us new rules.

Thanks so much for a great game, lots of positive energy and adjustment on areas that we highlighted/called early in the game. Overall communication was great. One constructive feedback: we felt there were a lot of pick calls from some of the female cutters, just something to be mindful of.
Thanks USA, that was a really fun game. We wanted to commend efforts to avoid contact and play a safe non-contact game.
Thanks GB, that was a very enjoyable game. We loved the positive energy, willingness to hear our perspectives and fair mind. So refreshing!

Thank you Australia for a great game. We felt you had a lot of really great positivity on the sidelines. We can appreciate that we may have had a lower tolerance of contact as other teams, however it is a non-contact sport so you should come out avoiding body contact irrespective of a teams tolerance level. Thank you for cleaning it up in the second half. Thanks Mel for the awesome spirit prizes and great sideline chat!

Thank you Canada that was a really fun game, we really appreciated the effort from many players to play non-contact, many of us noticed an improvement from the beginning of the game to the end as you adjusted. Some felt there was contact all the way through from some women. We appreciated the initiative to check in with us on dicey plays, injuries, and congratulate our plays. We loved that you learned our cheer and helped cheer it from the sideline.

spiritreceived.comments: Thank you Hong Kong for the game! We believe there’s room for improvement in communication, particularly by using hand signals for calls. Additionally, please avoid interfering with calls if you're not directly involved or if you're an off-field player
It was great spirit from the HK team! We loved playing against them
Thank you for your wonderful fair-mindedness.
It was a good game with our team mismatching gender and team Hong Kong being graceful in their acceptance of our apology. Great communication making sure everyone is respected!

Thank you for this wonderfully positive game, for looking after us with suncream and water and free hugs! Everything was awesome! The only feedback for both teams is to use hand signals more regularly and inform the rest of the players and sideline of calls before the discussions happen. Good luck with your other games!
